snippet.title: Energy Cycle - STEAM Trailer (1080p)
snippet.description:
Our new game 'Energy Cycle' coming to STEAM on January 13th, 2016!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/415960/

'Energy Cycle' – new puzzle game from the developers of ‘Energy Balance’ (current STEAM rating is 86% positive reviews). When you click each cell on the game field - it changes color, and the colors of adjacent cells horizontally and vertically. Your task to bring all the cells to the same color. Sounds pretty easy, but try to do it!

OST: SourOne - Fork Yourself
